notes.title: Update ver.1.1.1
notes.notes:
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug that allowed Boss Rush modes to be started in an unintended way.
[*]And other minor fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Update ver.1.1.0
notes.notes:
[h3]Additions[/h3]
[list]
[*]Added three types of Boss Rush modes. These modes become accessible from the base after clearing all main content.
[*]And other minor fixes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43497849/5d9f945454b159c118fc1fa9f0d155c97117026f.png[/img]
[/list]

notes.title: Update ver.1.0.1
notes.notes:
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug that could disable controls when dying in a specific part of the opening stage.
[*]And other minor fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Early Access Update ver.0.3.2
notes.notes:
[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Reworked the Order Chip 'Convalesce'.
[*]There is no longer any cost required when resetting enhancement levels.
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug that disabled all actions when executing the heal action during Swing.
[*]And other minor fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Early Access Update ver.0.3.1
notes.notes:
[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Improved visibility of bullets fired by certain enemies.
[/list]
[h3]Bugfixes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug that prevented some actions when performing specific operations.
[*]And other minor fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Early Access Update ver.0.3.0
notes.notes:
[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Implemented a new stage, "Elevated Highway"
[*]Added new Order Chips.
[*]Adjust the behavior of jump cancel during Dive Wire.
[*]Modified the behavior of the double jump.
[*]And other minor fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Early Access Update ver.0.1.1
notes.notes:
[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Changed conversation dialog to not terminated when enter the checkpoint.
[*]Improve the visibility of equipped Order Chips in the Equipment panel.
[/list]
[h3]Bugfixes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed a problem that player can enter the checkpoint during dive wire.
[*]Fixed a freeze bug that occurred under certain circumstances during the boss at the Sunken Station.
[*]And other minor fixes.
[/list]
